asr.full_text: Aqouf Kaqiba Assalam-o-Alaikum I'm Zia Tabarak from KC Now I'm at North Azabad and here we are at the famous and famous place to eat Karachi food Delhi Sohail Nihari Whenever we talk about Karachi food there are there are so many dishes that come to mind One such thing is Biryani, Haleem, Karachi Seekh Kebab & Karachi's Nihari Some names are pretty famous in Karachi and one of them is Delhi Sohail Nihari We have tried it many times and its great decided to share with you what's in store at Delhi Suheil Shall we? Hello how are you? Good thanks. You doing good? Yeah Nihari is popular, but I can see Biryani here too what is this? Chicken Karai as well? Wow, that's a traditional dish of Tikta Amazing! and is the chicken karahi here? Yes Chicken Karahi, Biryani and Nahari Look at the biryani How's you doing? I have been eating Suheils for 40 years Oh so you stay here? Many of my brothers are traveling here He went abroad to leave but in the end he got a call from the airport when we arrived in our apartment to catch a Nihari Hello Get Nihari and take it for us Greetings How are you all doing? The atmosphere here of Nihari is just amazing And check this rush The rush is going on here in Nihari and they are passing each parcel one after the other Really great atmosphere today This is the place where they're cooking the Nihari Meat is kept here They've put the meat & meat in the fryer & the water's in the cooker And the smell is amazing, can't tell you anything Pomegranate juice is a lot there they have full Pomegranate pieces yeah this is Nihari meat Nihari is made from Pomegranates check out the Qanari is cooked properly What's your name? Tufiyan You're in Parcel? Yes What's your name? Faradun How long have you been working here? More than thirty years Farah Doon How long have you been at Delhi Soil? About 3 years So it's been over 3 years! Marshalls Double pomegranate Salamani? How do we say Salamani? Salamani means that there's no Rorgans So if you don't want oil then go for Solemany It's an energetic atmosphere here and you don't find much time to waste There's Biryani here as well as some chicken and meat There's a line for Syrmal and Taftaan as well He's making chicken curry, and I have some meat on my table there too. And the smell has started to make my stomach very happy. The rotis are getting cooked and will be hot soon. But it's hard work to cook these beautiful rotis in this heat. I'm real and humble. I'm a Pakistani. So at the end I want to work and work and possible because we want to be honest, kind & free from every fear of the people of Pakistan. And we'll do our best. Hello, how are you? I am Rahman. I am the voice of Doman. He is my call center and my online call center, all the calls are coming to me. Yes and now you guys place orders in two lines. Our orders are happening in our lines. So, here we'll pay the rates online as well? Exactly, same rates. And when our charges reached the AC area, it costed us 50 rupees. Which is like the real price of petrol! but in every place only 50 Rs is charged its not the same that petronas charges You know this Covid situation has been going on in the past 2 years on and off restaurants are under any circumstances that's why Nihari has its own online delivery system is also made at Deli Sohail Nayhari You can order nayhari anywhere & call & order And the dish will reach you. Perfect! So the feedback of Deli Sohail Nayhari? You know what, the stuff here is really different. You come here and eat hot food from here, have their bread and eat it Is it fun? Never Okay now im here with Tajuddin shahab who is the owner of this new restaurant and lets ask him about his company since when did it started its been 62-83 How did this idea of Nihari Start? So we have bought a small hotel near the street How did you know about Niharga? We bought the hotel in Gali from somewhere small Balif sahab & I have been there I know to cook from whole wheat I have cooked Rotis & Oats Sanadoors , Nahari & Salad We established only a shop So what's your secret, what's the special part or the secret? I always say Allah's Mercy And what about you? But you have some other secrets ? No, I only prepare food which is available in the market I pray Allah for that Your name is Dailly Sohail Nihari Why you use the English word Daly ? Father came from there Oh from Delhi He came from there Father & mother It's a kind of bread Oh! So you're doing it one by one It's a series of things You can say that How much is a single Nalli Nihari? Rs.350 And a simple Nihari? Rs.250 And a Nalli Magaj Mix? Rs.550 250 Rupees And the Nalli Magaj mix? 550 Rupees And what's your name? Osama And you are Tajuddin's? He's my nephew Oh you're his uncle? Very nice So these are Tajuddin's nephews And the people who here for Nihari some are here since 30 years, some since 15 years and it's a very nice atmosphere here Is this hot? Yes They've used a stove here. Ohhh! The light in the house is on. This is Usama, he is in 8th grade. He's doing such a good job, wow! Great. I've come here from Hyderabad to have a Nari, and whenever I come here I eat here. Really? And to get it, I've come to study. Amazing, brother. I come to Delhi to get the Kisari! And today I'm in for Parshas! Wonderful! What's going on here? Making Masala! He's such a cute kid! What's your relationship to him? He's my relative I see, his relatives are all working here You've got speed! 6 I only passed for paper And you also do restaurant work! Well done Vajay here with me at Daily Swell Nahari Hamza Kazami thank you for liking our videos What's going on in the video There's special kheer too! Check this out, they've served kheer It's cold kheer, they've asked us to try it and taste it here This is traditional kheer in a clay bowl just try it here it's a traditional keer there's some pistachio on it This is delicious this was on cold It's really good! It's really cold! That's the main restaurant, and this is the family hall where the families come to have a meal and the real appeal of this dish is that they have their Nehari hot with Naan and tempera and that's the real taste I've got Nehari usher just arrived, just great we have Nihari here! and check it out, it's a mix Nihari it's only 550Rs we have bones here we can also see a very thick meat and we have to add the spices first We can really taste the black pepper powder. So the green masala is the important thing. And when you don't get the lemon tada on the Nihari then it's not delicious. This is really sour at the first bite. Amazing! Wow, this thick stew of Nihari salan and some Rohan on top... Now its time to taste it... It makes me happy! A big bite! It's really good! I was waiting for this to be done so my heart fluttered So when I tasted it & found it ... It was awesome! And the one in the middle is a goat So good! And check it out, there's another brain here... That's where the goat's brain is located. And that's why this Nalli Magaz Mixt Niyari costs 550 PKR . There's a whole brain inside it. Really delicious! And its amazing! The taste of it takes a mix with the sauce The taste of it takes an example of the three things It's a dish that is easily consumed by 3 to 4 people, even if you're hungry, but I'm fine with just 3 of us Now you check the quality of the meats all the things they make with each other because the flavour that goes into this stew is basically that of meat they cook this whole night after that they release this authentic taste of daily sohail niharia we have double naihari here, people can easily fit three to four people people who come here for 2 plates and he always gives me this now this is the double Nihari, 3-4 people have that so here we have people going for shocking Nihari and here this restaurant has that that too? Yes So one person can easily come for two plates in one Nihari a special Nihari with naalib mazaz its like the people from Palawan and also people from shocking Hot roti came, Hot naan has also arrived for eating with hot naan, it tastes great these are sooo beautiful this is the family business so many things are done by her You just give someone else's dish & he won't let me taste that So one thing I know, people do stay close to each other So Nihari's really good and Amir Abul Haz is sat with us while he eats So let's finish our Nihari And if you're in Karachi It's not necessary to tell us which are here If you've came from outside Karachi please come to this street If you can't at your home, then ask for one and you'll feel good Really really delicious! Music So anyways, this is the ending of today's video about the same tasty Dheeli Suhail Nihari hope you all enjoyed it, and if you did then please Like and Share it and if you ever come to Dheeli Suhail N Lihari and let me know their recipes See you in the next episode, Allah hafiz!
